name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 26, 2020 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Certificate of Recognition to Joel Gomez USA Track & Field 2019 Male Junior Para Athlete of the Year presented by Richard Robert
4B.
Presentation by students of Ocean Knoll and Park Dale Lane Elementary Schools regarding the elimination of single-use plastics on campus.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the January 29, 2020 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-02-26 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-02-26 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Alert & Warning Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego and the City of Encinitas Contact Person: Management Analyst Yum
1) Approve the Alert & Warning Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego in consultation with the City Attorney, and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or her designee, to execute the Memorandum of Agreement on behalf of the City of Encinitas.
2020-02-26 Item 08C Alert and Warning MOA with the County of San Diego
8D.
Agreement for Implementation of the Encinitas Habitat Stewardship Program with the San Diego Botanic Garden. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Authorize the City Manager to enter into a two-year agreement with the San Diego Botanic Garden for implementation of the Encinitas Habitat Stewardship program priority areas, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form for an amount not to exceed $99,650.
2020-02-26 Item 08D San Diego Botanic Garden EHSP Agreement
8E.
Network security firewall annual support renewal. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
Authorize Firewall license annual support renewals for $18,299 using the National Association of State Procurement Officials (NASPO) ValuePoint (AR626) and California Participating Addendum No. 7-14-70-11, for an overall contract amount not to exceed $107,751.
2020-02-26 Item 08E Authorize network security firewall annual support renewal
8F.
Purchase 800 MHz Replacement Radios and Peripheral Equipment approved in the City’s Capital Improvement Program (CIP) project WC18A from Motorola Solutions, Inc. Contact Person: Deputy Fire Chief Ford
Authorize the Encinitas Fire Department to utilize the Request for Proposal (RFP) approved by the County of San Diego to award Motorola Solutions, Inc. an agreement to provide for the purchase of 800 MHz radios and peripheral equipment.
2020-02-26 Item 08F Purchase 800 MHz Radios from Motorola
8G.
Lease Agreement Amendment between the City of Encinitas and T-Mobile West Tower LLC. Contact Person: Management Analyst III Roff
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 2 of the Lease Agreement between the City of Encinitas and T-Mobile West Tower LLC; and 2) Approve the dedication of lease revenue, estimated at $214,064 during the term of Amendment No. 2, for park improvement projects, CP04G.
2020-02-26 Item 08G T-Mobile Cellular Communication Lease Amendment
8H.
Regional Transportation Improvement Program Amendment. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing related to the proposed projects; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-12, entitled “Resolution of the City of Encinitas Adopting/Approving an Amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2019 Through 2023.”
2020-02-26 Item 08H RTIP Amendment 2020
8I.
Consideration of an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA) on the Pacific View Property. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached 90-day Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA), in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, with the EACEA.
2020-02-26 Item 08I Exclusive Negotiating with EACEA
8J.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance No. 2020-01 Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 6.11 (Operations Permit: Special Events). Contact Person: Management Analyst III Roff
Adopt Ordinance No. 2020-01 entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Chapter 6.11 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Operations Permit: Special Events."
2020-02-26 Item 08J Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2020-01
8K.
Amendment #1 to Contract with Chen Ryan Associates for sidewalk design services on the south side of Leucadia Boulevard between Hymettus Avenue and Fulvia Street for Leucadia Boulevard Traffic Safety and Pedestrian Improvements Phase II Project (CS18B). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a design contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 in consultation with the City Attorney, with Chen Ryan Associates in the amount of $54,076 plus 15 percent contingency of $8,111, for a not-to-exceed amount of $62,187 to perform additional design services for the Leucadia Boulevard Traffic Safety and Pedestrian Improvements Phase II Project.
2020-02-26 Item 08K Amendment #1 Chen Ryan Contract
8L.
Contract Amendment No. 6 with LC Paving and Sealing Inc. to construct traffic calming, safety and/or operational improvements. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer II Goralka
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment No. 6 with LC Paving and Sealing, Inc. (LC Paving) in substantial form as attached, in the amount of $200,000 to construct certain traffic calming/safety improvements on city streets, for a total not to exceed 5 year contract amount of $2,046,500 (Attachment 1) for the General Mobility Improvement Project (CS18E).
2020-02-26 Item 08L LC Paving Contract Amendment
8M.
Award of contract to RRM Design Group for planning services, in an amount not-to-exceed $143,030; and authorize the City Manager to enter into a Professional Services Agreement for said services. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
Approve the Professional Services Agreement with RRM Design Group, in an amount not-to-exceed $143,030, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, including any amendments and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney.
2020-02-26 Item 08M RRM Design Group Contract
8N.
Approval of a new major special event at Encinitas Community Park and Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Environment Day for a community special event. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Approve a new major special event to be held at Encinitas Community Park and authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Environment Day (EEDAY) in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 in consultation with the City Attorney to host the Eco Fest event on Sunday, May 17, 2020 from 11 a.m. - 4 p.m.
2020-02-26 Item 08N EcoFest MOU
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing and Introduction of Ordinance 2020-02, an Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adding Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 11.29 – Plastic Bottled Beverage Ordinance, Implementing Phase 2 of the City of Encinitas Plastics Initiative. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Open the Public Hearing; and 2) Introduce Ordinance 2020-02, an Ordinance entitled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas adding Chapter 11.29 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting the Distribution of Plastic Bottled Beverages.”
2020-02-26 Item 10A Plastic Bottled Beverage Ordinance
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 11, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
